mapper.select: select b_num, b_rider, b_title, b_day, b_club from board where b_club=#{b_club}
select * from board where b_club=#{b_club} order by b_day desc
select cj_club from (select * from club_join where cj_rider=#{cj_rider} order by cj_join desc) where rownum < 2 and cj_withdraw is null
mapper.insert: insert into board(b_num, b_rider, b_title, b_content, b_day, b_file, b_club, b_subject) values(SEQ_BOARDNUM.nextval, #{b_rider}, #{b_title}, #{b_content}, SYSDATE+(9/24), #{b_file, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{b_club}, #{b_subject})
mapper.update: UPDATE BOARD SET b_title = #{b_title}, b_content=#{b_content} where b_num=#{b_num}
update board set b_hit=b_hit+1 where b_num=#{b_num}
